svg.text: PR #2169 · Make plugin install, update, and surface stop reliable
plugin stop killed only the sh wrapper and a failed setup left a clone that blocked retries;
now surfaces own a process group and installs clean up, so stop and retry always converge.
BEFORE
AFTER
plugin install SOURCE
copy_dir to plugin_root/NAME, then run install.setup
setup exits non-zero: dir stays behind, never registered
retry bails "already exists; remove it first"
remove bails "not installed"; fetched temp clone leaks
plugin install / update / remove
setup fails -> remove_dir_all(dest), "safe to retry"
unregistered leftover with the same manifest name is cleared
update keeps the old checkout as a backup, restores on failure
StagingDir deletes the fetched source on drop; install --force
plugin start -> sh -c START (pid = the sh wrapper)
stop(): kill PID signals only the wrapper
server is reparented to init and keeps its port
output -> /dev/null; no restart; reinstall deletes live binary
spawn_surface: process_group(0), output -> surface.log
halt_surface: SIGTERM group, wait 5s, SIGKILL, bail if alive
remove, update, and a stale start reap the surface first
plugin restart; status reports exited/unhealthy + log tail
setup env: HOME = .portal/home, service PATH
PATH lacks ~/.cargo/bin -> "sh: cargo: not found" (127)
errors returned from main print a Rust backtrace
plugin_command_env + plugin_path_env
prepend ~/.cargo/bin, ~/.local/bin; set CARGO_HOME, RUSTUP_HOME
exit 127 names the PATH; errors print as one Error: line
service_path also adds an existing ~/.cargo/bin to the unit
Launcher CLI only - the Portal UI/RPC for these actions lands separately; a pre-upgrade surface record is stopped via pkill -P, one level deep.
